scams.name: Currency Bait-and-Switch
scams.setup: Street taxi (not app-based) agrees to a flat number with no currency stated up front.
hook_dialogue: It was fifty dollars, not fifty pounds
scams.mechanism: Ambiguous verbal price lets driver reinterpret currency after the ride is complete and leverage sunk-cost/no-alternative pressure.
scams.countermeasure: State currency explicitly before entering the vehicle ('50 Egyptian pounds, confirm?'). Prefer app-based rides (Uber/Careem/InDrive) where price is fixed pre-ride.

scams.name: Fake Uber / Unlicensed Approach
scams.setup: Someone approaches at airport/street claiming to be the booked rideshare driver, no app confirmation.
scams.mechanism: Exploits traveler fatigue/urgency at arrival; once in the car, no app record means price is whatever the driver decides.
scams.countermeasure: Never accept a ride without matching the license plate and driver name shown in-app first.

scams.name: In-App Price Override
scams.setup: Ride booked correctly via app, but driver demands more cash or foreign currency at drop-off.
hook_dialogue: App price too low, pay more
scams.mechanism: Relies on traveler not knowing local norms/refusing is possible; social pressure to avoid conflict.
scams.countermeasure: Pay only the in-app amount. Screenshot the fare if needed. This is refusable without confrontation risk since it's a documented transaction.

scams.name: Terminal Transfer Misinformation
scams.setup: Airport taxi driver claims a paid car is required to move between Cairo airport terminals.
hook_dialogue: No walking, too far, you need taxi
scams.mechanism: Traveler unfamiliar with layout has no way to verify claim in the moment.
scams.countermeasure: Terminals 2 and 3 are walkable; a free/cheap monorail connects to Terminal 1. Verify with airport signage, not touts.

scams.name: En-Route Interception / Fake Road Closure
scams.setup: Men flag down or block a taxi heading to Giza pyramids, claim the road ahead is closed.
hook_dialogue: You must take camel from here
scams.mechanism: Creates false urgency to force an on-the-spot switch to a commission-paying camel/horse operator before the tourist can verify.
scams.countermeasure: Stay in the vehicle, tell the driver to continue to the official gate; treat unofficial street 'closures' as near-certain scams.
